name: ys-ll/uniterm
title: ys-ll/uniterm
headline: Uniterm combines remote access with shell agents
lede: Users can access SSH, RDP, SFTP, databases, and Kubernetes in a terminal whose built-in agent plans and runs multi-turn shell commands.

effects.effect: Places multi-turn execution inside a terminal
Brings operational connections and agent work together
Makes command permissions an integration concern
